universe_notes: Free public ticker catalog. Keep assetType=stock with subType stock|unit. Tickers matching XXXX + ending 3|4|5|6|11. Exclude fractional (*F), ETFs, FIIs and other funds from the stock feed. BDRs are NOT taken from type=bdr wholesale — only tickers listed in bdr_allowlist are added.
universe_notes_panel: Painel: Ações = brapi type=stock (sufixo 3/4/5/6 e units 11 subType=unit). BDRs = só bdr_allowlist. ETFs = brapi subType=etf (giro brapi >= fund_prefilter_turnover_brl) + etf_static. FIIs = carteira do IFIX (B3). RS: FIIs vs IFIX (proxy XFIX11), demais vs ^BVSP.
